faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Find answers to the most common questions about our hosting services.

faqs.question: What types of hosting do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer game server hosting (Minecraft, Hytale, ARK, CS2, Rust, FiveM), VPS hosting, and bot hosting solutions. Each service is optimized for its specific use case.

faqs.question: How do I get started with Horizon Hosting?
faqs.answer: Simply choose your hosting plan, select a server location, and complete the checkout process. Your server will be provisioned instantly, and you'll receive login details via email.

faqs.question: Do you offer DDoS protection?
faqs.answer: Yes, all our hosting plans include enterprise-grade DDoS protection to keep your servers safe from attacks. We use advanced mitigation techniques to ensure 99.9% uptime.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can upgrade your plan at any time through your control panel. We offer seamless upgrades with no downtime to your servers.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and various cryptocurrencies. All payments are processed securely through our payment gateway.

faqs.question: Is there a money-back guarantee?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all our hosting plans. If you're not satisfied, we'll refund your purchase—no questions asked.
